summary: Audited all 93 catalog items with category 'Grains & Cereals'. The set covers a solid breakfast-cereal and whole-grain core, but is undermined by a pervasive naming defect: many base staples carry a processed-form suffix in their name even though their id is the bare grain (id 'millet' is named 'millet porridge', id 'barley' is 'barley groats', id 'cornmeal' is 'cornmeal porridge', id 'wheat' is 'wheat bran', id 'oat-bran' carries oat/oatmeal aliases). This both mislabels the item and corrupts the parent/child tree (millet varieties hang off 'millet porridge'; wheat berries hang off 'bran'). There are also gluten-free tagging errors (freekeh and kamut are wheat, kamut tagged GF; the generic 'bran'/'groats' buckets tagged GF despite including wheat/barley/rye forms), several alias collisions and copy-paste duplicates (sorghum-white reuses sorghum's aliases; pearl-barley aliased 'pearl millet'; rice-bran aliased 'rice porridge'), and a non-grain item ('potato-flakes', instant mashed potato) miscategorised here. Coverage gaps are large and global: only ~9 rice types exist (no red rice, black/forbidden rice, parboiled/converted, glutinous/sweet rice as a distinct item, paella/bomba, calrose, koshihikari, carolina gold, matta/kerala red, camargue, calasparra, valencia, broken/jasmine-brown), and whole-grain staples sorghum is present but pearl millet, job's tears (coix), wild-harvested grains, cracked wheat, wheat berries (as its own item), rye berries, triticale, brown/red/black rice flakes, rice cakes, instant/parboiled rice, mochi/glutinous, and many global porridges (atole, mamaliga, ugali, sadza, injera-teff, ogi/pap, congee already buried as a porridge alias) are missing. Recommend liberal global expansion.
issues: NAMING: id 'millet' is named 'millet porridge' — it is the base grain millet, not a porridge. The four millet varieties (barnyard, foxtail, proso, finger-millet) are all named '<x> millet porridge' for the same reason and parented under it.
NAMING: id 'barley' is named 'barley groats'; the base whole-grain barley should be 'barley'. 'pearl-barley' is correctly a child but named 'pearl barley groats'.

NAMING: id 'cornmeal' is named 'cornmeal porridge' and parented under 'porridge'; cornmeal is a dry milled corn product, not a cooked porridge. Children 'cornmeal-white'/'yellow-cornmeal' inherit the wrong name.

NAMING: id 'wheat' is named 'wheat bran' and parented under 'bran', yet its aliases are 'wheat berries','wheat grain','whole wheat' — i.e. it is meant to be whole wheat / wheat berries, not bran. Mislabeled and mis-parented.
NAMING/ALIAS: id 'oat-bran' (named 'oat bran', parent 'bran') carries aliases 'oatmeal','oat groats','grain groats','groat','whole groats' — these belong to oats, not oat bran. Alias bleed.

TAXONOMY: there is no single canonical 'wheat berries' item; whole wheat is conflated into the 'wheat bran' entry. Likewise no canonical 'oat groats' (folded into oat-bran) and no canonical 'cracked wheat'.
GLUTEN: 'kamut' (khorasan wheat) is tagged Gluten-Free — incorrect, it is a wheat species and contains gluten.
GLUTEN: 'freekeh' is tagged Gluten-Free — incorrect, freekeh is roasted green durum wheat and contains gluten.

GLUTEN: generic buckets 'bran' and 'groats' are tagged Gluten-Free, but as written they encompass wheat bran / barley & rye groats which contain gluten; a generic bucket should not assert Gluten-Free.

GLUTEN: 'multigrain-porridge' and 'multigrain cereal' family — multigrain-porridge is tagged Gluten-Free but multigrain mixes typically include wheat/barley/rye; should drop GF unless specified gluten-free.
CATEGORY: 'potato-flakes' (instant mashed potato / dehydrated potato flakes) is not a grain or cereal; it belongs in 'Produce' or 'Other', not 'Grains & Cereals'.
ALIAS COLLISION: 'pearl-barley' (pearl barley) lists 'pearl millet' as an alias — pearl millet is a different grain (bajra), not pearl barley.
ALIAS COLLISION: 'rice-bran' lists alias 'rice porridge', and 'cream-of-rice' also lists alias 'rice porridge' — rice bran is not rice porridge; duplicate/incorrect alias.
ALIAS DUPLICATION: 'sorghum-white' copies the exact aliases of 'sorghum' ('jowar','milo','sorghum grain','sorghums') — the white-sorghum child should not reuse the parent's full alias list.

ALIAS: 'durum' (durum semolina) and 'semolina' both alias 'semolinas'; durum is a wheat species while semolina is its milled product — hierarchy is fine but durum's alias should reference durum wheat, not 'semolinas'.
FRESHNESS: 'hominy grits' has Refrigerated [3,7] and Pantry [365,1095] — the values mix canned/cooked hominy (short fridge life) with dried hominy (long pantry life) in one item; ambiguous.

FRESHNESS: cereal-family items (cereal, corn-flakes, bran-flakes, oatmeal cereal, puffed-rice, rice-puffs, shredded-wheat, wheat-squares) have no Frozen entry while most other grains do — inconsistent storage map (cereals are rarely frozen, so this may be intentional but is uneven).
GRANULARITY: 'cold-cereal' is named 'cold cereal multigrain' and parented under 'multigrain cereal' — odd specificity; the generic 'cold cereal' concept is already an alias on 'cereal'.

COVERAGE: rice is thin — missing red rice, black/forbidden rice, parboiled/converted rice, glutinous/sweet rice (only 'sticky rice' exists), paella/bomba/valencia/calasparra, calrose, koshihikari, carolina gold, matta/kerala red, camargue red, broken rice, brown jasmine/basmati, rice flakes (poha), puffed/flattened rice.

COVERAGE: missing global whole grains/pseudo-grains — pearl millet (bajra), job's tears (coix/hato mugi), triticale, rye berries, wheat berries (canonical), cracked wheat, oat groats (canonical), Kamut as wheat, einkorn/emmer present, fonio present, but black/red rice, wild rice present.

COVERAGE: missing many global porridge/prepared staples — atole, mamaliga, ugali/sadza (maize meal porridge), injera batter (teff), ogi/pap, tsampa (roasted barley), and congee is buried only as an alias on 'porridge'.
redundancies: id 'barley' is named 'barley groats' and 'pearl-barley' is 'pearl barley groats'; once 'barley' is renamed to plain barley the two are distinct, but as currently named both read as barley-groats forms and overlap.
oat-bran carries aliases 'oatmeal','oat groats','whole groats' that belong to 'oats'; the two overlap heavily and oat-bran's aliases should move to oats.
both list alias 'rice porridge'; one of them is wrong (rice bran is a milling byproduct, cream-of-rice is a cooked rice cereal).
id 'millet' named 'millet porridge' overlaps conceptually with the generic 'porridge' bucket; the grain millet should be split from any porridge sense.
cornmeal (named 'cornmeal porridge') and polenta are the same ground-corn product at different grinds/origins; acceptable as siblings but the 'porridge' naming on cornmeal blurs them.
grits and polenta are both coarse-ground corn; near-duplicates distinguished mainly by region (US South vs Italy) and corn type — keep both but note overlap.
'quick grits' (id 'quick') carries alias 'quick oats' which duplicates the oats/oats-instant line; the alias is misplaced.

cleanups.fix: Rename 'millet porridge' -> 'millet' (the base grain). Keep porridge sense out of this item; update children barnyard/foxtail/proso/finger-millet names from '<x> millet porridge' to '<x> millet'.
Rename 'barley groats' -> 'barley'; it is the canonical whole barley. Re-point children pearl-barley/pot/quick-cooking to this. Note: barley contains gluten — keep GF OFF (already off).
Rename 'cornmeal porridge' -> 'cornmeal'; re-parent off 'porridge' (cornmeal is a dry milled product). Rename children cornmeal-white/yellow-cornmeal to '... cornmeal'.

This item (id 'wheat', name 'wheat bran', parent 'bran', aliases wheat berries/whole wheat) is mislabeled. Split: make 'wheat' = whole wheat / wheat berries (parent none, NO Gluten-Free) and create a separate proper 'wheat bran' under 'bran'. Or rename to 'whole wheat' and move bran aliases out.
Remove aliases 'oatmeal','oat groats','grain groats','groat','whole groats' from oat bran — they belong to 'oats'/new 'oat groats'. Keep only true oat-bran aliases.
Remove 'Gluten-Free' tag — kamut/khorasan is a wheat species and contains gluten. Tags should be Vegetarian, Vegan, Dairy-Free, Nut-Free.
Remove 'Gluten-Free' tag — freekeh is roasted green durum wheat and contains gluten. Tags should be Vegetarian, Vegan, Dairy-Free, Nut-Free.
Drop 'Gluten-Free' from the generic 'bran' bucket (it spans wheat/oat/rice bran, not all gluten-free), or split into wheat-bran (gluten) vs rice/oat-bran (GF).
Drop 'Gluten-Free' from the generic 'groats' bucket; it covers barley/rye/buckwheat groats with mixed gluten status.
Reconsider 'Gluten-Free' — multigrain blends usually contain wheat/barley/rye; drop GF unless the product is certified gluten-free.
Move out of 'Grains & Cereals' — instant mashed potato / dehydrated potato flakes belong in 'Produce' (or 'Other'); it is not a grain or cereal.
Remove alias 'pearl millet' — that is bajra (a millet), not pearl barley. Rename name 'pearl barley groats' -> 'pearl barley'.
Remove alias 'rice porridge' — rice bran is a milling byproduct, not a porridge; rice porridge belongs to congee/cream-of-rice.
Replace copy-pasted parent aliases ('jowar','milo','sorghum grain','sorghums') with white-sorghum-specific aliases (e.g. 'white jowar','white milo','pearl white sorghum').
Remove alias 'quick oats' from 'quick grits' — it belongs to oats/oats-instant; keep grits-specific aliases only.
Tags are 'Vegetarian, Gluten-Free, Nut-Free' — cream of rice is plain rice, so it is also Vegan and Dairy-Free; add 'Vegan' and 'Dairy-Free' (it omits both, inconsistent with other rice items).
Tags are only 'Vegetarian, Nut-Free' — cream of wheat (farina) is plant-based, so add 'Vegan' and 'Dairy-Free' (it is wheat, so correctly NOT Gluten-Free).
Alias 'semolinas' duplicates the parent 'semolina'; replace with durum-wheat-specific aliases ('durum wheat','triticum durum','hard wheat').
Name 'cold cereal multigrain' / id 'cold-cereal' is oddly specific and overlaps the 'cold cereal' alias already on 'cereal'; consider merging into 'multigrain cereal' or generalizing.

Freshness mixes dried (Pantry 365-1095) and canned/cooked (Refrigerated 3-7) hominy in one item; split into 'dried hominy' (pantry) and 'canned hominy' or pick one form to keep the freshness map coherent.
